messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — our hosted reservations in us-west are showing ~25% idle capacity over the last 7 days.

ogun: Seen that. Is the overhang concentrated on p4d or a mix?

maria: Mostly p4d (committed 120 GPUs), observed sustained peak ~88-96. Burst spikes hit 115 once on Monday. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/hosted/reservations/us-west

jess: billing-bot flagged potential mismatch on instance family tags earlier.

billing-bot: Invoice alert: reserved instance utilization flagged 72% utilization for us-west during billing window 2026-03-01..2026-03-07. See ticket #BILL-428.

ogun: Could be routing policy — some tenants pinned to eu region and we route into us-west when eu is full. Need to check smart-routing logs.

maria: Agreed. Also curious if kv-cache warmups are causing longer seqs and reducing throughput and artificially inflating needed capacity.

paul: How urgent? Customer-facing SLAs unaffected but cost delta for unused commitments is material (~$180k/quarter).

maria: Let's quantify before proposing changes. Action items:
- ogun: dump reservation allocation by model family + region (CSV)
- jess: pull smart-routing histogram for last 14 days
- billing-bot: attach per-reservation hourly utilization to BIL-428

ogun: I'm on it, will drop CSV here by EOD.

jess: I'll run the histogram query now: `select region,model_family,count(*) from routing_logs where timestamp>now()-14d group by 1,2;`

maria: If we see >15% sustained idle on a particular hardware class, proposal is to reprofile commitments at next renewal (downgrade some p4d -> a100x2/quantized pool) and introduce cross-region overflow discount.

billing-bot: Added hourly utilization file to BIL-428. Link: https://billing.redwood/tickets/BIL-428/files/usage.csv

paul: OK — sync 2pm to review CSV and cost model. Bring runbook adjustments if we throttle hosted routing.

maria: thx. small note — include a quick sim: reallocate 20 GPUs to eu and run synthetic workload to validate latency impact (no SLA change).

ogun: noted, will schedule a canary in eu with 4 nodes first.

jess: ping me once the CSV is in; I'll overlay routing topology to see if any pinning misconfig happened.

maria: Great. If anyone finds a specific reservation with <50% util and >72h idle stretches, flag it with `#reserve-reshuffle` tag so we can action fast.

paul: :thumbsup:
